definition: In this historical source, psychometry is used for the measurement of mental processes in their time relations. It refers to what the same classification also calls mental chronometry.

reasons: The packet only shows a cross-reference: “Psychometry (see Time Relations, IV. 6)” and the related heading “Time Relations of Consciousness; Mental Chronometry.” It does not explicitly state that psychometry means measurement of mental processes in their time relations, so the definition adds unsupported wording.
